transitions.action: phase := 1; Pump_Motor is enabled in this same scan by output mapping
phase := 2; Filling_Valve is enabled in this same scan by output mapping
phase := 3; Capping_Machine is enabled in this same scan by output mapping
phase := 4; Packing_Machine is enabled in this same scan by output mapping
phase := 5; Completion_Light is enabled in this same scan by output mapping
reset priority: phase := 0; all outputs are cleared in this same scan; do not start a new cycle in this scan even if bottleSensor is TRUE

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timer reset conditions are required because no timers are instantiated.
timer_plan.notes: All phase transitions are event-driven by level-sampled sensor/button inputs. No delay, timeout, debounce, or pulse-stretch timer is specified.

priorities: Safety and mutual exclusion first: at most one of Pump_Motor, Filling_Valve, Capping_Machine, Packing_Machine, Completion_Light may be ON after any scan.
Reset priority: in COMPLETE, finishedButton transitions to IDLE and clears all outputs in the same scan; no new cleaning start is allowed in that scan.
Active phase restriction: only the confirmation button matching the current phase may advance the state; all other confirmation inputs are ignored.
One phase transition maximum per scan; no multi-step skipping is permitted even if several buttons are held.
IDLE start only when IDLE and bottleSensor is TRUE; the pump starts in the same scan as the transition to CLEANING.
COMPLETE holds Completion_Light until finishedButton is TRUE.
Outputs are derived solely from the post-transition phase in one unified output block to prevent conflicting actuator commands.
No timers are used; no conditional timer calls are needed.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample all six BOOL inputs once into scan-level registers. Compute rising-edge flags from the current sample and previous-scan samples. Store current samples as previous samples for the next scan. Edge flags are diagnostic only; phase transitions use the level-sampled inputs.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Set transitionTaken := FALSE. Apply reset priority first: if phase=COMPLETE and finishedButton=TRUE, set phase:=IDLE and transitionTaken:=TRUE; suppress all further transitions this scan. Otherwise, if IDLE and bottleSensor=TRUE, set phase:=CLEANING; else if CLEANING and cleaningConfirmButton=TRUE, set phase:=FILLING; else if FILLING and fillingConfirmButton=TRUE, set phase:=CAPPING; else if CAPPING and cappingConfirmButton=TRUE, set phase:=PACKING; else if PACKING and packingConfirmButton=TRUE, set phase:=COMPLETE; else hold. Ignore nonmatching confirmation inputs. Allow at most one transition per scan.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: Call all timer function blocks unconditionally at top level, outside CASE/IF. No timers are configured in this design, so this stage is an explicit no-op.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign all outputs from the post-transition phase in one block: IDLE all OFF; CLEANING Pump_Motor ON and all others OFF; FILLING Filling_Valve ON and all others OFF; CAPPING Capping_Machine ON and all others OFF; PACKING Packing_Machine ON and all others OFF; COMPLETE Completion_Light ON and all others OFF.

formal_assertions.formula: G(!(Pump_Motor & Filling_Valve) & !(Pump_Motor & Capping_Machine) & !(Pump_Motor & Packing_Machine) & !(Pump_Motor & Completion_Light) & !(Filling_Valve & Capping_Machine) & !(Filling_Valve & Packing_Machine) & !(Filling_Valve & Completion_Light) & !(Capping_Machine & Packing_Machine) & !(Capping_Machine & Completion_Light) & !(Packing_Machine & Completion_Light))
